subject: Marine works - Southwestern Shore - Big Tancook Island, NS
text:
Marine works - Southwestern Shore - Big Tancook Island, NS
Ferry terminal construction underway in Northwest Cove on Big Tancook Island, NS. daily during daylight hours.
Work area demarcated by two green flashing lights installed on the west end of the new wharf structure.
Multiple work boats, tug and barges will be on site monitoring VHF Ch 16 and sailing daily between Blandford, NS and Big Tancook Island, NS.
Minimum wash and wide berth requested.
                                                    Cancels NW-M-0951-25
